body:
alex: Heads up — seeing a p99 spike on hosted API in us-west right now. p95 ~ 380ms, p99 jumped to ~1.4s around 08:12 UTC. Queue depth for runtime worker pool climbed to 48/50 during the window. :grimacing:

deploy-bot: deploy canary->prod (sha: d3f4a2c) completed at 08:09 UTC :white_check_mark:

priya: @alex do we have a recent change to kernel selector or kvcache prefetch? I remember a selector heuristic tweak landed in PR #1234 this morning.

mateo: I pulled the profiler traces — a bunch of requests fell back to `fallback_generic_gemm` on layer 24 for seq=3072 small-batch runs. commit `abcde1f` touched selector thresholds for batch-size heuristics.

alex: Profiler snippet (local capture, coarse):
```
[08:12:15] request id=abc-001 batch=1 seq=3072
kernel selected: fallback_generic_gemm (exec=6.18ms)
optimized_kernel: fused_attn_gemm_v2 (est=0.92ms)
KV cache prefetch: miss rate 43% -> extra overhead
queue_wait_ms: 85
end-to-end: 1420ms (p99)
```

jen: Graphs from metrics:
- small-batch traffic spike from tenant `corp-omega` at 08:10
- rate limiter headroom ~0.2 rps at the moment of spike
- worker queue depth aligns with the tail latency increase :eyes:

infra-sre: We flagged `corp-omega` as noisy. Their routing token didn't map to the reserved pool due to an env var mismatch in routing service (version bump earlier). No autoscale triggered for dedicated capacity.

priya: Two quick mitigation ideas: 1) force kernel selector to prefer `fused_attn_gemm_v2` for relevant layer sizes until we root-cause heuristics, 2) cap kvcache prefetch concurrency to reduce contention, 3) bump rate limiter for the noisy tenant or apply per-tenant throttling. Thoughts?

mateo: I can flip selector flag and restart a few runtimes. command: `redwoodctl runtime set-flag --name kernel_selector.prefer_fused=true --scope us-west`

alex: Executed the selector flip on a subset (3 nodes) at 08:14. Immediately saw p99 drop to ~430ms in those nodes' metrics, queue depth reduced to ~20. Leaving selector flip in place while we investigate commit `abcde1f`.

deploy-bot: hotfix deploy by alex (patch: revert-selector-heuristic) merged at 08:15 UTC :rocket:

jen: Summary / next steps:
- short-term: keep selector override until we ship a proper patch to the heuristic (action: mateo)
- mid-term: add unit/regression test capturing small-batch seq=3k path to prevent fallback selection (action: priya)
- infra: fix routing env mismatch so noisy tenants go to reserved pool / autoscale (action: infra-sre)
- observability: add a kernel-selection tag to traces for faster triage (action: eng-runtime)

alex: Thanks everyone. I'll continue monitoring dashboards and post updates. If p99 climbs again, we revert to emergency-throttle for `corp-omega` and pin model variant. :thumbsup:
